name: rights-offering
filingText: Filed Pursuant to Rule 424(b)(5) Registration No. 333-280500 PROSPECTUS SUPPLEMENT Saba Capital Income & Opportunities Fund Rights Offering We are distributing 10,000,000 transferable rights to holders of our common shares as of the record date of June 2, 2026. Every three rights entitle the holder to purchase one new common share. Up to 3,333,333 shares of common stock are issuable upon exercise of the rights. The subscription price will be determined by a formula based on the greater of 95% of market price or 90% of net asset value. The rights will expire on June 30, 2026 unless extended. Rights holders may exercise an over-subscription privilege. The rights will trade on the NYSE under the symbol "BRW RT". Estimated net proceeds are approximately $48.0 million.
